subject.title: fix(compaction): prevent repeated restarts after safety timeouts

question: Should native compaction persist one explicitly marked partial result after the safety-timeout abort while the reason-owned settlement token remains open?
rationale: This deliberately moves the authoritative session-state boundary past the wrapper timeout and changes post-commit hook ordering, so tests and proof cannot substitute for owner intent.

options.title: Accept bounded partial commit
options.body: Permit only wrapper-marked partial results during the expiring reason-owned window, retaining coverage for external aborts, unmarked results, late settlement, and hook ordering.

options.title: Keep timeout terminal
options.body: Reject every post-abort persistence attempt and pursue persistent checkpoints, resumable chunk state, or different stage budgeting instead.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded partial commit
recommendation.body: Permit only wrapper-marked partial results during the expiring reason-owned window, retaining coverage for external aborts, unmarked results, late settlement, and hook ordering.
